paragraphs: A Land Rover AJ300P engine rebuild starts from £3,200, regardless of which of the five models it's fitted to — the price tier is set by the engine, not the badge on the vehicle. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available. Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.

cards.title: Rebuilding Your
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Land Rover already has instead — strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most AJ300P owners choose.

cards.title: Replacement
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting — sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: Used
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call — particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk a used unit carries.

options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild — a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle — restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.

Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers, regardless of which of the six AJ300P-equipped models you drive.

faqLeft.q: What is the Land Rover AJ300P engine?
faqLeft.a: The AJ300P is Jaguar Land Rover's 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine, part of the Ingenium family introduced in 2019. It's available in mild-hybrid and plug-in hybrid configurations.

faqLeft.q: Which Land Rover models use the AJ300P?
faqLeft.a: Defender (L663), Discovery (L462), Range Rover (L460), Range Rover Sport (L461) and Range Rover Velar (L560) — see the full applications table above for exact variants and years.

faqLeft.q: Does the AJ300P differ between Land Rover models?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The specific ancillaries, mounting, and hybrid-system integration differ by application, even though the base engine code is the same. MHEV and PHEV variants differ significantly.

faqLeft.q: Is an AJ300P from one Land Rover model compatible with another?
faqLeft.a: Not automatically. A Defender AJ300P isn't a drop-in match for a Range Rover AJ300P — ancillaries, mounting, and hybrid-system integration all differ. We always confirm compatibility by registration/VIN.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover AJ300P engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £3,200, regardless of which model it's fitted to. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.
Yes. We work on AJ300P rebuilds across every model it's fitted to, replacing worn components as standard.

faqLeft.q: Do you work on AJ300P hybrid applications?
faqLeft.a: Yes. AJ300P MHEV and PHEV applications are within our workshop capability, with the relevant hybrid-system ancillaries accounted for once your exact model is confirmed.

faqRight.q: Can you rebuild an AJ300P from a Defender P400?
faqRight.a: Yes. The AJ300P in the Defender is one of the applications we work on regularly.

faqRight.q: Can you rebuild an AJ300P from a Range Rover P550e?
faqRight.a: Yes. The AJ300P in the Range Rover P550e PHEV application is within our workshop capability.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Land Rover AJ300P engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Land Rover if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an AJ300P engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your vehicle arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most AJ300P owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history — a particular concern given the different hybrid configurations across the Land Rover range — and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
